title: Hang a name board at the entry
where: north face, front of the beam above the entry (x=6, y=5, z=3) or a post at (2,4,3)
instruction: Add B.sign('spruce', ['CHASHITSU','TEA HOUSE'], {facing:'north', color:'black'}) as a wall sign on a solid post/beam face with 1 cell of air in front; if the roof eave blocks it, use a hanging sign on a dark_oak_fence arm at (5,4,2).

title: Steepen and curve the eave tips
instruction: Edit build.mjs eave-tip loop: replace the single full block with an outer_left/outer_right deepslate_tile_stairs at y6 plus a deepslate_tile_slab (top) at y7 pointing outward so the corner sweeps up two courses; run mcd check + render front-left.

title: Kumiko grid on the shoji panels
where: north, west, east and back wall panels, y=3..4
instruction: Run mcd paint on the wall faces: 'north where snow_block -> mullions dark_oak_trapdoor every 2' (or glazing grid with frame dark_oak) so each paper panel gets dark cross-bars; keep the panels at least 50% white.

title: Second stone lantern and path edging
instruction: Copy toro(x,z) in build.mjs to toro(10,0); add stone_brick_slab stepping stones at (9,1,1),(8,1,0) and moss_carpet on grass between them.

title: Maple: thinner crown with branches
instruction: In maple(): add 2 dark_oak_log branches at y=5 reaching x=0 and x=2, scatter the crown 15% air holes, mix 10% orange_terracotta... or red_terracotta for autumn tone; keep the crown within x0..3, z0..3.

title: Hanging lanterns on chains along the eaves
instruction: Use fixture(g,{at:[x,5,z], face, mount:'hang'}) or B.chain('y') then B.lantern(true) under the beam so 4 more lanterns hang on the rhythm.

title: Bamboo / shrubs in the back garden
where: back strip z=10 and sides x=0,x=12
instruction: Add bamboo (y1..3) clumps and azalea bushes where grass is bare; 6-8 cells max; keep clear of the deck rail.

title: Fill gable lattice and add a ridge ornament
where: front gable plane z=3, y=6..8 and ridge top (5..7,9,6)
instruction: Fix the gable pattern so it is symmetric: dark_oak trapdoors (open, south) at (5,6,3),(6,6,3),(7,6,3),(6,7,3) with snow_block elsewhere; then place a dark_oak_slab / lightning_rod finial on the ridge if the 9-high limit allows (swap one ridge slab for a rod).

title: Weather the roof tiles and footings
instruction: mcd paint 'roof -> vary textured deepslate_tiles,cracked_deepslate_tiles' and 'all faces ground row -> weather light' to break up the uniform dark slab and stone footings.
